title: Sri Aurobindo: Spiritual Nationalism and Integral Yoga

scenes.text: Is a nation just geographical land, or a living spirit?
scenes.narration: Imagine someone telling you that your homeland is just dirt and borders on a map. Aurobindo Ghosh rejected this colonial claim, declaring that India has always been a divine, immortal soul.

scenes.text: A family home is not just bricks and cement, but a living bond of love.
scenes.narration: Here is an analogy to make this click. Your home is not merely bricks and cement; it is the living love of your mother and family. Similarly, Aurobindo saw India as Mother India, a divine mother uniting all her children.

scenes.heading: Two Approaches to Freedom

columns.title: Moderate Leaders
items: Saw British rule as a blessing

scenes.narration: Early Moderate leaders treated British rule as a blessing in disguise and used polite petitions. Aurobindo mocked this as political beggary, arguing that freedom requires mass resistance and radical boycott.

scenes.name: Aurobindo Ghosh
scenes.idea: Nationalism is not a political program, but a sacred divine religion.
scenes.narration: In his famous writings, New Lamps for Old, Aurobindo insisted that swaraj is not mere good administration. To him, complete liberation is an absolute moral value because the nation is a divine spirit.

scenes.heading: Pillars of Spiritual Nationalism
items: Neo-Vedantism recognizes unity beneath human diversity
Mother India represents collective awakening and Shakti
India must rise to spiritually guide humanity
scenes.narration: Aurobindo drew from Vivekananda's Neo-Vedantism, which teaches that a single divine spirit unites everyone despite surface differences. Therefore, India's freedom is not selfish pride, but a sacred mission to guide world humanity.

scenes.heading: Journey of Integral Yoga
scenes.narration: True freedom also happens inside you. Through Integral Yoga, personal sacrifice and disciplined practice transform our fragmented, confused thoughts into a supermind that realizes the universal spirit.

items: India is an eternal divine spirit, not mere geography
Swaraj means complete liberation achieved through mass resistance
Integral Yoga unites humanity through individual spiritual evolution
scenes.narration: Remember these three big takeaways: the nation is a sacred living faith, true swaraj requires unconditional liberation, and inner spiritual growth unites all humanity. Keep this vision in mind, and you will ace PSIR!
